name: list_quota_infos
description: Lists QuotaInfos of all quotas for a given project, folder, or organization. Expected request structure: 'parent' (string, format: projects/{project}/locations/global/services/{service}, folders/{folder}/locations/global/services/{service}, or organizations/{organization}/locations/global/services/{service}), 'page_size' is automatically fixed to 100. Filtering is supported only on quota_id. Does not return any information about current quota usage. Quota usage can be fetched by calling list_timeseries tool of google cloud monitoring.

parameters.description: Message for requesting list of QuotaInfos

pageSize.description: Optional. Requested page size. Server may return fewer items than requested. If unspecified, server will pick an appropriate default.

pageToken.description: Optional. A token identifying a page of results the server should return.

parent.description: Required. Identifier. Parent value of QuotaInfo resources. Listing across different resource containers (such as 'projects/-') is not allowed. Example names: `projects/123/locations/global/services/compute.googleapis.com` `folders/234/locations/global/services/compute.googleapis.com` `organizations/345/locations/global/services/compute.googleapis.com`
